goalbuddy_receipt_v1.rationale: T003 is genuinely green: the fixture emits deterministic .blend/.glb artifacts, six renders, CAS references, geometry QA, provenance, and truthful LOCAL_ONLY_NOT_APPROVED status. It remains a script-only workflow with no production-run contract, CLI/API/MCP entrypoint, promotion receipt, or viewer smoke proof. Approve one cohesive local-only orchestration slice reusing the fixture, sandbox boundary, CAS, and existing viewer. External QA, Unity, providers, signing, and public release remain deferred.

worker_package.objective: Implement one local production-run contract that validates prompt/reference metadata and six required views, invokes the existing deterministic fixture through a fixed network-denied Blender subprocess, emits explicit run and promotion state without false approval, and exposes the same operation through the CLI, HTTP API, and typed MCP surface for Codex and Claude Code. Add a smoke test proving the generated project validates, serves its current GLB/QA, and reaches the existing viewer route.
verify: run_dir="$(mktemp -d)"; python3 -m open3d_artist production-run --recipe examples/production-qualification/recipe.json --output "$run_dir" && python3 -m open3d_artist validate "$run_dir"
stop_if: Any required product change falls outside allowed_files.
The runner requires network access, provider credentials, Unity, Meshy, All2API, arbitrary shell/Python execution, or an unsandboxed fallback.
The CLI, HTTP, or MCP path accepts arbitrary filesystem or command execution instead of a fixed recipe contract.
Promotion state could claim APPROVED without external visual QA and Unity evidence.
The generated run cannot expose validation, current GLB, promotion state, and viewer-serving proof.
Verification fails twice without a clear local fix.

parallel_safety.reason: T004 is the only active task and the selected package is the sole write-capable follow-up.
